newsitem.title: USA: Mohawk expects certain prices to abate.
newsitem.headline: Mohawk expects certain prices to abate.

text.p: Mohawk Industries Inc said on Wednesday that it expected the increase in polypropylene resin prices to level off during the next six months.
Its projection comes as it said it saw some margin erosion in polypropylene resin in the latter part of the third quarter because of cost increases.
Mohawk also said its nylon carpet prices softened at the end of the third quarter.
Mohawk produces woven and tufted broadloom carpet and rugs.
